entities.summary: Michiana Shores is a town in Springfield and Michigan townships, LaPorte County, Indiana, United States. As of the 2020 census, Michiana Shores had a population of 306. It is included in the Michigan City, Indiana-La Porte, Indiana Metropolitan Statistical Area. Michiana Shores is located in northwesternmost Springfield Township, and is the township's sole incorporated community.
